# shc_events (Data Source)

Fetches recent CloudEvents from the SHC events feed (lifecycle, billing, orders).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of events to return (default: 20).

### Read-Only

- `events` (String) JSON-encoded array of CloudEvent objects.
